user.title: Connect to the IPMI server
user.description: Enter the BMC connection details. Leave advanced options unchecked unless you need addon, Kg key, or privilege settings.

data_description.advanced: Addon URL, interface, Kg key, privilege level, sensor filters, and connection backend

advanced.title: Advanced IPMI settings
advanced.description: Addon and connection settings. Sensor filters are on the next step.

data_description.kg_key: Optional. Requires the ipmi-server addon; not supported by the python-ipmi fallback.
data_description.ipmi_server_host: On Home Assistant OS use the addon hostname, not localhost.
data_description.addon_interface: Usually lanplus. Use auto to let ipmitool decide.
data_description.addon_extra_params: Optional raw ipmitool arguments (for example cipher suite).
data_description.backend_preference: auto = try addon first then RMCP (historical default). rmcp = python-ipmi only (skips addon probes). Warning: the send_command service requires the addon and will not work with rmcp.

advanced_extras.title: Sensor filters
advanced_extras.description: Optional sensor discovery settings. Clear all types for power status and chassis controls only (requires ipmi-server 2.6+ for BMC polling).

data.create_energy_sensors: Create energy sensors from power readings

data_description.sensor_types: Only selected types are created for newly discovered sensors. Leave empty for power-only monitoring on limited BMCs (for example Sipeed NanoKVM).
data_description.create_energy_sensors: Requires power in sensor types. Each discovered power sensor also gets a kWh energy sensor for the Energy dashboard (enabled by default).

rmcp_warning.title: RMCP-only mode
rmcp_warning.description: You selected rmcp (python-ipmi only). The custom send_command service will not work — it requires the ipmi-server addon or standalone HTTP API. Sensors and chassis power controls still work. Submit to continue, or go back to choose auto/addon.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure IPMI server
reconfigure.description: Update BMC connection details for this entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate IPMI server
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication failed for {host}. Enter updated credentials.

init.title: IPMI options
init.description: Filters apply only to newly discovered sensors. Existing entities are left unchanged until the entry is reloaded after enabling a type.

data.create_energy_sensors: Create energy sensors from power readings

data_description.sensor_types: Only selected types are created for newly discovered sensors. Leave empty for power-only monitoring on limited BMCs (for example Sipeed NanoKVM).
data_description.backend_preference: auto = try addon first then RMCP (historical default). addon = addon only. rmcp = python-ipmi only (skips addon probes). Warning: the send_command service requires the addon and will not work with rmcp.
data_description.create_energy_sensors: Requires power in sensor types. Each discovered power sensor also gets a kWh energy sensor for the Energy dashboard (enabled by default). Energy entities are unavailable when power is not monitored, this option is off, or the power sensor entity is disabled.
data_description.power_off_delay: After soft shutdown, keep the power switch off for this many seconds even if the BMC still reports power on. 0 disables (switch follows live BMC state immediately). Does not affect the State sensor.
